data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A decentralized network is fundamentally less resilient to correlated failure because it lacks the 'Global Immune Response' capability of a centralized entity.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The centralized control plane itself becomes the primary vector for the correlated failure (the 'God-mode' failure).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The decentralized network implements a gossip-based autonomous mitigation protocol that mimics a global response.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"While a large service may suffer a correlated crash, its 'strictly more internal redundancy' is paired with a unified control plane capable of implementing a global circuit breaker or an instantaneous configuration rollback. In a decentralized network, the 'independence' that prevents synchronization also prevents coordinated mitigation.
